name: Subject and question
purpose: Give an abstract question a tangible subject.
inputs: Person or object footage, key terms, a question, and the explanatory focus
examples: Psychology: seeing and understanding; history: people and their times; society: individuals and groups
motion: Establish the complete subject, then introduce the concepts and question in reading order.

name: Concept comparison
purpose: Compare two easily confused concepts at a common scale.
inputs: Two concepts, a shared subject, and an explanation of each
examples: Knowing / understanding; intention / outcome; policy / implementation
motion: Show both sides together, then emphasize each in turn. Do not use red crosses as a shortcut for right and wrong.

text_slots.q: 同一件事，两种理解的深度

name: Chapter sequence
purpose: Give a longer passage a clear route through the ideas.
inputs: Two to five short headings, chapter footage, and the active item
examples: Observe / question / explain / reassess; origin / channel / node / impact
motion: Build the chapter sequence in left-to-right Chinese reading order, shifting emphasis with the narration.

text_slots.note: 每一步，都让前一个问题变得更清楚

name: Evidence and interpretation
purpose: Ground a judgment in observable evidence and context.
inputs: Source images, a detail to focus on, and two levels of explanation
examples: Pages and interpretation; archives and people; images and context
motion: Keep source material flat and readable, then shift attention from the key detail to its interpretation.

name: People and relationships
purpose: Show who influences whom and how they are connected.
inputs: People or entities, relationship labels, and direction
examples: Friends and choices; cities and trade; organizations and institutions
motion: Introduce the subjects, establish their relationships, then emphasize the key connection.

name: Feedback loop
purpose: Explain how a behavior reinforces itself.
inputs: Three stages, a genuine feedback connection, and a way out
examples: Expectation / action / feedback; pressure / avoidance / greater difficulty starting
motion: Complete the connections in sequence, then hold the closed loop instead of rotating it continuously.

text_slots.note: 短暂的轻松，也可能强化下一次回避

name: Quantity and probability
purpose: Put a conspicuous result back in the context of the full sample.
inputs: Total, selected count, units, and whether the data is factual or illustrative
examples: Three outcomes across ten attempts; proportions across different groups
motion: Establish the whole before highlighting a subset. Values must match the number of objects shown.

text_slots.title: 先看见整体，再讨论结果

name: Time and turning points
purpose: Show the same subject changing over time.
inputs: Three stages, a subject, a turning point, and actual years or stage names
examples: Before and after an event; the formation of a viewpoint; changes in an institution
motion: Move time consistently in one direction and leave enough reading time at turning points.

text_slots.t: 一个判断，是怎样改变的

name: Map location
purpose: First establish where the story takes place.
inputs: Base map, extent, focus coordinates, place names, and historical period
examples: Cities, mountain passes, ports, and cultural regions
motion: Move from the region to the location, keeping camera movement and markers in the same coordinate system.

text_slots.note: 先给空间坐标，再进入人物与事件

name: Routes and diffusion
purpose: Show direction of travel, stops, and sequence.
inputs: Base map, route coordinates, stops, sequence, and an indication of whether the route is factual or schematic
examples: Migration, trade routes, diplomatic journeys, and the spread of knowledge
motion: Reveal the route in segments, introducing place names as it reaches them. Animation speed does not represent travel time.

name: Periods and geographic extent
purpose: Compare spatial changes between two periods on the same base map.
inputs: Dates for both periods, a shared projection, and boundary data and sources for each
examples: Territories, administrative areas, areas of control, and cultural diffusion
motion: Keep scale and viewing extent consistent. Alternate or juxtapose layers, and identify uncertain boundaries.

text_slots.t: 保持同一尺度，才能比较
text_slots.note: 同一底图 · 同一比例 · 不同观察范围

name: Detail and context
purpose: Bring overlooked conditions into the explanation.
inputs: A single source image or clip, a focal detail, the full view, and a change in judgment
examples: The context of a statement; the situation behind an expression; a detail in an artifact
motion: Start with the detail, then widen the view while keeping the original subject in the frame.
